geonames.title: GeoNames VE dump + VE alternate names

notes: stateCode / municipalityCode are OCHA COD-AB P-codes (VE15, VE1501); ISO 3166-2 is on state entries.
City and sector state/municipality come from point-in-polygon on full-resolution COD polygons, not from GeoNames admin codes.
population is GeoNames' figure; vintage varies by record and it is not a census measurement.
variants = accentless form, GeoNames es/abbr/unlabelled alternate names, rule-based abbreviations (Pto., Cdad., Edo., Mcpio.), and curatedVariants (hand-written, listed separately).
Dependencias Federales has no municipalities; the OCHA placeholder VE2501 is excluded here.
